solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Tough boss marks a test badly (10)

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 10 letters
anagram indicator

annotation.surface: A harsh teacher is grading an exam unfairly.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a complaint about a strict examiner, which is exactly what the answer is, so the fodder hides in plain sight.
annotation.definitionFit: A taskmaster is someone who drives others hard, a tough boss.

entries.clue: Love a way out, reportedly (5)

indicatorNotes.reportedly: what is reported is heard, so we go by sound

blocks.note: a door is a way out of a room

annotation.surface: Someone sees love as an escape route.
annotation.walkthrough: Read 'Love' as a verb: to adore is to love.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both verbs mean feeling strong affection for someone.

entries.clue: Recoil before rotten start of match (4-3)

indicatorNotes.before: in a down clue, the first piece comes before the second

blocks.note: a gun's kick is its recoil
food gone off is rotten

annotation.surface: Someone flinches away from something rotten before a game.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Start of match' looks like it asks for the letter M; it is the definition, the kick-off being how a football match starts.
annotation.definitionFit: The kick-off is the moment a football match begins.

entries.clue: Objective of Taoism regularly displayed (3)

indicatorNotes.regularly displayed: letters shown at regular intervals: every other one

blocks.note: the 2nd, 4th and 6th letters of tAoIsM

annotation.surface: The goal of the Taoist philosophy is shown on a regular basis.
annotation.walkthrough: Take every second letter of TAOISM, starting with the A.
annotation.definitionFit: An aim is an objective, something you are trying to achieve.

entries.clue: Excellent T-shirt, say, seen on artist? (3-6)

indicatorNotes.say: a T-shirt is one example of a top
indicatorNotes.seen on: in a down clue, the first piece sits on top of the second

blocks.note: a T-shirt is a kind of top
one who draws is a drawer

annotation.surface: Someone asks whether an artist is wearing a great T-shirt.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Artist' is read literally as someone who draws, a DRAWER; the answer is the adjective top-drawer, meaning first-rate.
annotation.definitionFit: Top-drawer means of the highest quality, excellent.

entries.clue: Start again with some spare newspapers (5)

indicatorNotes.some: only some of the letters are used

blocks.note: spaRE NEWspapers

annotation.surface: Someone restarts a job using a few leftover newspapers.
annotation.walkthrough: The answer runs across the gap between the two words.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym for the verb, as when you begin a lease or subscription afresh.

entries.clue: Appear with last of coffee blend (6)

blocks.note: the final letter of coffeE
to merge is to blend

annotation.surface: A coffee blend appears, down to the dregs.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Blend' looks like a coffee noun, but it is the verb, blend = merge.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both verbs describe coming out into view.

entries.clue: Film master of ceremonies going into space (6)

indicatorNotes.going into: one piece goes into the other

blocks.note: room = space
MC is the standard abbreviation, placed inside RO-OM

annotation.surface: A film's compere is heading off into outer space.
annotation.walkthrough: RO(MC)OM. A romcom is a romantic comedy film.
annotation.definitionFit: A romcom is a kind of film, a romantic comedy.

entries.clue: Old airline associated with a country (6)

blocks.note: Pan Am, the defunct American airline
used as it stands

annotation.surface: A former airline was linked to one particular nation.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'country'; the 'a' before it belongs to the wordplay.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the Central American nation that gives its name to the canal and the hat.

entries.clue: Reject animal doctor with duck (4)

blocks.note: a vet treats animals
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so O

annotation.surface: A vet refuses to treat a duck.
annotation.walkthrough: A duck is a batsman's score of zero in cricket, so it gives the letter O.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both verbs mean formally refusing a proposal, as a president blocks a bill.

entries.clue: Anxious racer won after transformation (8)

indicatorNotes.after transformation: the letters appear once they have been transformed

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 8 letters
anagram indicator

annotation.surface: A nervous driver has won after a makeover.
annotation.walkthrough: Careworn describes a face lined by worry, so it stands for 'anxious' here.
annotation.definitionFit: Careworn means showing the strain of worry, which fits anxious.

entries.clue: Asian district damaged with canon (9)

indicatorNotes.damaged: damaged letters are broken and rearranged

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 9 letters
anagram indicator

annotation.surface: Part of an Asian city was hit by cannon fire.
annotation.walkthrough: It is 'canon' with one N, a rule or clergyman, not the gun; 'with' is part of the fodder, not a link.
annotation.definitionFit: A Chinatown is a district of a city with a large Chinese community.

entries.clue: One with fine motor skills? (7,6)

blocks.note: the surface reading: fine motor skills are the precise hand movements used in writing or sewing
the setter's reading: someone skilled at fining motorists, by issuing parking tickets

annotation.surface: Someone with good fine motor skills, the neat hand movements of a craftsman.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Fine motor skills' normally means dexterity; here it is being skilled at fining motorists. A traffic warden in Britain issues parking tickets.
annotation.definitionFit: A traffic warden's job is to give parking fines to motorists.

entries.clue: Almost lifting dried fruit (6)

indicatorNotes.Almost: almost the whole word: drop its last letter

blocks.note: RAISING, lifting, without its final G

annotation.surface: Some dried fruit is nearly being picked up.
annotation.walkthrough: Lifting = RAISING; cut the last letter.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: dried grapes are one kind of dried fruit.

entries.clue: Part of plant is concerning performer (7)

blocks.note: re = concerning, as in memo headers
an actor is a performer

annotation.surface: A botany note about part of a plant and a performer.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks botanical but means a power plant: the reactor is its core.
annotation.definitionFit: A reactor is the part of a nuclear power plant where the reaction happens.

entries.clue: Ancient creature from Sudan and Rio mixed up (8)

blocks.note: anagram fodder, 8 letters; 'and' just joins them
anagram indicator

annotation.surface: An old animal has come from Sudan and Rio in a muddle.
annotation.walkthrough: The place names are only letters here.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: these reptiles are the best-known creatures of prehistory.

entries.clue: Internet forum holds back frequently (5)

indicatorNotes.holds: the phrase holds the answer inside it
indicatorNotes.back: going back means travelling the wrong way, so the letters are read right to left

blocks.note: interNET FOrum

annotation.surface: An online forum keeps holding things back time and again.
annotation.walkthrough: Read 'Internet forum' right to left and OFTEN appears across the join.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both adverbs mean many times over, again and again.

entries.clue: Help Lincoln, say, with head of treasury (4)

indicatorNotes.say: Lincoln is an example of an Abe
indicatorNotes.head of: the head of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: Abraham Lincoln was known as Abe
first letter of Treasury

annotation.surface: Someone offers to help President Lincoln alongside the head of the Treasury.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Lincoln, say' asks for a name he is an example of: Abe.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, though the word usually means helping in wrongdoing, as in 'aid and abet'.

entries.clue: Avoid advert during night before (5)

indicatorNotes.during: the advert happens during, so inside, the night before

blocks.note: the eve is the night before an event
ad is short for advert, placed inside EV-E

annotation.surface: Someone dodges a commercial shown the evening before.
annotation.walkthrough: EV(AD)E.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both verbs mean keeping clear of something, such as a question or a tax.

entries.clue: Pen found outside street restaurant (6)

indicatorNotes.found outside: the pen goes round the outside of the street

blocks.note: a Biro is the common British word for a ballpoint pen
St is the abbreviation for street, placed inside BI-RO

annotation.surface: A pen has been found outside a restaurant on the street.
annotation.walkthrough: BI(ST)RO. A Biro is the everyday British name for a ballpoint pen.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a small, informal, French-style kind of restaurant.

entries.clue: American uncle on plane discarded goods (6)

indicatorNotes.on: in an across clue, the uncle goes on after the plane

blocks.note: a jet is a plane
Uncle Sam personifies the USA

annotation.surface: An American's uncle is on a flight with some thrown-out luggage.
annotation.walkthrough: Blocks are in answer order: the uncle is written 'on' after the plane.
annotation.definitionFit: Jetsam is cargo thrown overboard from a ship, discarded goods.

entries.clue: Scribble a little bit (3)

blocks.note: a verb: to write something down quickly
a noun: a tiny amount, like an iota

annotation.surface: Someone asks for a brief scrawl.
annotation.walkthrough: The verb and the noun are the same word: jot down, and not one jot.
annotation.definitionFit: To jot is to write quickly; a jot is a tiny amount.

entries.clue: Main course is something bound to fail? (10)

blocks.note: a main course is, literally, not a starter
an idea with no chance of success

annotation.surface: A diner complains the main dish is a doomed idea.
annotation.walkthrough: The first definition is playful: a starter is the British word for a first course, so the main course is a non-starter.
annotation.definitionFit: A nonstarter is a plan or idea with no chance of success.
